showcases.title: Emergence — Sierpiński Generator
showcases.description: A small rule. A random choice. An unexpected universe. Explore eight living fractals in an interactive, narrated chaos-game studio.

showcases.title: Paper Puppet
showcases.description: A paper character, some real-world rules, and your move. Walk, jump, pose the skeleton, go limp, and dodge obstacles.

showcases.title: Spectra Shader
showcases.description: A WebGL shader studio. Explore fractal and generative scenes, tune form, color, and motion, then share a frozen moment as a URL.

showcases.title: PHASEFORM — Phased Antenna Array
showcases.description: Explore the anatomy of a phased-array antenna. Explode eight hardware layers, inspect every subsystem, and steer a beam through the physics of phase.

showcases.title: Little Planet Worlds
showcases.description: A self-contained 3D adventure on a tiny living planet. Wander forests, villages, deserts and glaciers as Pineapple Monster or Explorer, gather, craft, build a home, and find passages to stranger worlds.

showcases.title: COLLAPSE
showcases.description: Build a civilization, corrupt its institutions, and turn the wheel of history. A playable historical strategy campaign of cities, councils, divine powers, and the long arc from founding to fall.

showcases.title: The Wheel of Empires: Anacyclosis Simulator
showcases.description: Polybius's seven-stage cycle of civilizations, as an interactive essay. Step or auto-play each regime, make dynastic choices in a generational saga, and read period newspapers as monarchies, republics, and mobs rise and fall.
showcases.author: Darren Hicks

showcases.title: Helios: Solar Cycles & Extreme Events Explorer
showcases.description: Interactive chronology of solar cycles, Miyake events, and historic superflares. Explore Gleissberg, Suess, and Hallstatt oscillations alongside tree-ring radiocarbon spikes and polar ice-core records, with search, filters, and a navigable energy-scale timeline.

showcases.title: Water Cycle Simulation
showcases.description: Closed hydrologic cycle across ocean, valleys, and mountains. Day/night temperature, orographic rainfall, evaporation, condensation, and downhill runoff with conserved water.

showcases.title: Supply & Demand Economic Simulator
showcases.description: Comprehensive economic simulation showcasing market dynamics in a closed economy with 50 agents. Features real-time supply and demand curves, multiple economic scenarios (scarcity, abundance, tech boom, demand surge), market interventions (price floors/ceilings, taxes, subsidies), and a money printer mechanism. Watch producers, consumers, and traders interact through order books with detailed agent statistics, wealth inequality tracking, and exportable simulation data.

showcases.title: Galton Box Physics Simulation
showcases.description: Interactive physics simulation of Sir Francis Galton's bean machine demonstrating the Central Limit Theorem. Features delta-time collisions, live binomial overlay, mean/σ comparison to theory, presets from ideal to chaotic, and adjustable gravity, bounce, geometry, and drop rate.

showcases.title: Bitcoin Strategic Reserve - US States Progress
showcases.description: The current progress of the Bitcoin Strategic Reserve in the United States (as of May 7, 2025)

showcases.title: Geo Economic Simulator - Claude 3.5 Sonnet
showcases.description: A simulation of a global economy over time, with a focus on the relationship between GDP, population, and resource availability.

showcases.title: Social Security Scenario Simulator
showcases.description: Comprehensive Social Security benefits calculator with break-even analysis. Input your earnings history to see monthly benefits at different retirement ages (62-70), compare lifetime totals with COLA adjustments, and analyze investment scenarios. Features detailed year-by-year projections, visual break-even point detection, and CSV export for financial planning.

showcases.title: Last Stack Standing - Money Printer Simulation
showcases.description: Monte Carlo table-stakes experiment: equal starting stacks, dice decide each round, and the last stack wins. Compare fair play with a money-printer that recapitalizes Player 1 using newly created chips. Sweep bailout counts to map win rate, inequality, wealth share, and inflation with confidence intervals.

showcases.title: 3D Interactive PhotoCube
showcases.description: A WebGL-powered 3D photocube with interactive controls and animations.

showcases.title: FPS Photo Realm
showcases.description: Walk around through a WebGL rendered world built of your own Photos and Art

showcases.title: Multi 3D Interactive PhotoCubes
showcases.description: A WebGL-powered Array of 3D photocubes with interactive controls and animations.

showcases.title: Geo Economic Simulator - Gemini Pro Created
showcases.description: A simulation of a global economy over time, with a focus on the relationship between GDP, population, and resource availability.

showcases.title: Geo Economic Simulator - Manus Created
showcases.description: A simulation of a global economy over time, with a focus on the relationship between GDP, population, and resource availability.

showcases.title: Cryptoquote
showcases.description: Newspaper-style cryptogram game: decode substitution-cipher quotes, play a daily puzzle, or encrypt your own and share it.

showcases.title: Sudoku
showcases.description: Classic 9×9 Sudoku. Difficulty is how many squares you start with — Easy through Expert — with a daily puzzle, notes, and hints.

showcases.title: Logic Grid
showcases.description: Classic magazine logic problems: four people, three attributes, and a handful of clues. Easy through Nightmare.

showcases.title: Knights Journey
showcases.description: A knight’s tour on an 8×8 board. Hop only to unused squares. Score is how many stones you leave behind — 0 is perfect.

showcases.title: Nonogram
showcases.description: Picture-logic puzzles. Row and column numbers tell you which cells to fill — Easy 5×5 through Nightmare 20×20.

showcases.title: Mastermind
showcases.description: Crack a hidden row of colored pegs. Red keys mark the right place, white keys mark the right color elsewhere — Easy through Nightmare.

showcases.title: Othello
showcases.description: Classic Othello against the computer. Black and white stones on a green board — Easy through Nightmare.

showcases.title: Massive Tree Viewer
showcases.description: Interactive particle system with physics simulation using Canvas API.

showcases.title: Particle System
showcases.description: Interactive particle system with physics simulation using Canvas API.

showcases.title: GL Shaders
showcases.description: WebGL Shader Demonstration with lots of configurable tweaks to play with.

showcases.title: SVG Animation
showcases.description: Complex SVG animations with morphing and path animations.
